Replace Symbols in Expressions

Source: R/symbolics.R
replaceSymbols.Rd

Substitutes symbols in character expressions. A replacement that is not a single symbol, a non-negative number, a function call or already bracketed is put in parentheses, so x/a with a = "b+c" becomes x/(b+c). Only variables are replaced, not function names, argument names or list elements; the rest of the text is left as it is.

Usage

replaceSymbols(what, by, x)

Arguments

what

Character vector, the symbols to replace.

by

Character or numeric vector, the replacements, recycled to the length of what.

x

Character vector of expressions, one per element. Names and attributes are kept; NA and "0" are returned unchanged.

Value

x with the symbols replaced.

Examples

replaceSymbols("a", "b+c", c(r1 = "x/a", r2 = "exp(a)*a^2"))
#>                 r1                 r2 
#>          "x/(b+c)" "exp(b+c)*(b+c)^2" 
replaceSymbols(c("a", "b"), c("b", "a"), "a - b")
#> [1] "b - a"
